facts.readmeExcerpt: AI Bobby is a local-first desktop gateway that puts OpenCode's free model pool, WorkBuddy (CN)

en.title:
All your models.
One endpoint.
en.body: A local gateway for macOS that folds free-tier pools like OpenCode and NVIDIA together with WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI into one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Four sources today, more on the way — three protocols, four clients, one key, and a native control panel for imports, backups and restores.
en.cardBody: A local gateway for macOS that folds free-tier pools like OpenCode and NVIDIA together with WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI into one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Four sources today, more on the way — three protocols, four clients, one key.

features.title: Every pool, one catalog
features.body: Free-tier pools such as OpenCode and NVIDIA sit beside WorkBuddy CN and WorkBuddy AI, with per-model pricing, multi-account round-robin and failover. New pools join the same catalog.

features.title: Every protocol
features.body: Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages share one canonical stream.

features.title: One-click import
features.body: Dry-run diff, automatic backup and idempotent writes for Codex, Claude Code, DSH and WorkBuddy.

features.title: Loopback by default
features.body: Loopback only, browser Origin requests rejected, keys stored 0600, zero telemetry.

en.note: 0.2.3 (NVIDIA NIM) is in internal beta; the public beta is 0.2.2. WorkBuddy still requires you to scan the official QR code yourself. The current build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized.

zh.category: 本地 AI 网关 / MACOS
zh.title:
所有模型。
一个端点。
zh.body: 一个运行在 macOS 本机的 AI 网关：把 OpenCode、NVIDIA 这样的带免费额度的模型池，与 WorkBuddy、WorkBuddy AI 收进同一个 OpenAI 兼容端点。今天四个来源，以后还会更多——三种协议、四个客户端、一把 Key，外加原生控制面板管理导入、备份与恢复。
zh.cardBody: 一个运行在 macOS 本机的 AI 网关：把 OpenCode、NVIDIA 这样的带免费额度的模型池，与 WorkBuddy、WorkBuddy AI 收进同一个 OpenAI 兼容端点。今天四个来源，以后还会更多——三种协议、四个客户端、一把 Key。

features.title: 多源合一，一份清单
features.body: OpenCode、NVIDIA 等带免费额度的模型池，与 WorkBuddy CN、WorkBuddy AI 并列展示，带每条模型的计价提示、多账号轮询与故障转移；新模型池接进同一份清单。

features.title: 协议全说
features.body: Chat Completions、Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 共用同一条规范化事件流。

features.title: 一键导入
features.body: 先看 dry-run diff，再自动备份并幂等写入 Codex、Claude Code、DSH 与 WorkBuddy。

features.title: 默认只走回环
features.body: 只监听回环地址，拒绝浏览器 Origin 请求，Key 以 0600 存放，零遥测。

zh.note: 0.2.3（NVIDIA NIM）在内测中，公开 beta 仍是 0.2.2。WorkBuddy 仍需你亲自扫描官方二维码登录；当前构建为 ad-hoc 签名，尚未公证。

facts.readmeExcerpt: O Muse 是一个 macOS 桌面应用（Tauri 2 + React 19），把音乐制作相关的

en.title:
Every stem.
Under your control.
en.body: A local-first macOS suite that turns music-production chores into focused apps. Stem Player, Kontakt Library Manager and Audio Plugin Manager share one toolbox and one rule: audio stays on your machine.
en.cardBody: A local-first macOS suite that turns music-production chores into focused apps. Stem Player, Kontakt Library Manager and Audio Plugin Manager share one toolbox and one rule: audio stays on your machine.

features.title: Stem Player
features.body: Split vocals, drums, bass and other with Demucs. Practice with M/S, shift key ±12 semitones, slow down to 50–120%.

features.title: Kontakt Library Manager
features.body: Find missing paths, duplicate SNPIDs and broken volumes; create or repair .nicnt files without touching the registry by hand.

features.title: Audio Plugin Manager
features.body: Scan AU / VST / VST3 / AAX / CLAP, sort by disk usage, move across volumes with symlinks, restore or trash safely.

features.title: Born local
features.body: Separation runs on-device. Online is only for update checks and a one-time runtime download.

en.note: 0.3.0 (UI v2) is implemented and in preview; the public beta is 0.2.2. The first separation downloads a separate runtime (~259MB).

zh.title:
每一轨。
都由你掌控。
zh.body: 一个本地优先的 macOS 工具箱，把音乐制作的琐事拆成专注的小 App：分轨播放器、Kontakt 音源库管理与音频插件管理。同一条规则：音频留在你的机器上。
zh.cardBody: 一个本地优先的 macOS 工具箱，把音乐制作的琐事拆成专注的小 App：分轨播放器、Kontakt 音源库管理与音频插件管理。同一条规则：音频留在你的机器上。

features.title: 分轨播放器
features.body: 用 Demucs 拆出人声、鼓、贝斯与其他四轨。M/S 选练习轨，±12 半音改调，50–120% 调速。

features.title: Kontakt 音源库管理
features.body: 找出缺失路径、重复 SNPID 与断卷；创建或修复 .nicnt，不必手改注册表。

features.title: 音频插件管理
features.body: 扫描 AU / VST / VST3 / AAX / CLAP，按占用排序，跨卷移动时留软链，安全还原或移入废纸篓。

features.title: 生来本地
features.body: 分轨在本机完成；联网只用于检查更新与首次下载运行时。

zh.note: 0.3.0（UI v2）已实现并在预览；公开测试版为 0.2.2。首次分轨需下载独立运行时（约 259MB）。
